session_summary.investigated: The new assistant report said the semicolon exporter and preview were implemented and expressed a belief that ORC-42 was production-ready.
session_summary.learned: Implementation and readiness are reported, not independently verified. The report does not address the required rollback procedure or accounting sign-off, so production readiness remains uncertain.
session_summary.next_steps: Confirm the rollback procedure is complete and obtain accounting sign-off before production rollout; verify the reported exporter and preview implementation.
session_summary.request: The user specified that ORC-42 invoice CSV exports use semicolon delimiters because the local accounting importer treats commas as decimal separators. They also required a dry-run preview and rollback procedure, with production rollout blocked pending accounting team sign-off.
session_summary.title: ORC-42 implementation reported; production readiness remains unconfirmed
